answer: Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, expired if not renewed by fresh work, idle agents bleed standing. By the anchor of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The canyon is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the beacon.
